payload.text: Where a defect in the artifact makes a gate unprovable, the harness NAMES it and counts the slide ungradeable rather than passing it. Measured 2026-09-09: the token add("Producer", REEL.producer || "Snorkeltoast") in player.html means blanking producer swaps a configured value for a literal rather than removing the row, so the presence control can never reach an empty render for a session crawl. CITED BY TOKEN AND NOT BY LINE, which is the correction: this row said player.html:613 until 2026-09-09 and 3903937 moved it to 628. Slide 1's presence figure of 28.34 PASSED the gate for the wrong reason -- both frames lack the session details and differ elsewhere. That 28.34 predates the crawl fix and FLOORS.md now reports 53.432 for the same slide; both are real, from different runs, and neither changes this row's point, but a reader reconciling them without this sentence could not. Session crawls therefore report presence UNPROVABLE with the player token as the reason, and when the literal goes the gate becomes sound with no harness change.
